# Bs2FoB

> Essays by Bs2FoB on cognition, reasoning tools and method, published in Korean (original) and English. The core is the Cognitive Axioms series (인지공리).

Every post is a static HTML file readable without JavaScript. Korean files end in `.ko.html`, English files in `.en.html`; the Korean text is the original and the English is the author's translation. Series numbers read `set_part` (e.g. `02_3` is set 2, part 3). Machine-readable index: https://bs2fob.com/posts.json

## Writing

- [<Cognitive Axioms 01_0> Established Foothold](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w376v154_foothold.en.html): Finishing is not perfecting. A procedure for deciding what unit of work counts as done. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w376v154_foothold.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 02_1> Abduction](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v164_abduction.en.html): Only abduction opens a hypothesis space. Deduction and induction work inside it. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v164_abduction.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 02_2> The Pragmatic Maxim and Information Theory](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v165_maxim.en.html): How to judge what abduction opens: Peirce's maxim and Shannon's information. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v165_maxim.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 02_3> The Intelligence Trichotomy](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v170_trichotomy.en.html): HI · SI · PI. Splitting what the word intelligence lumps together into three. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v170_trichotomy.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 03_1> The Emergence of Lifeforms](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v175_living.en.html): Entropy and time, attractors and Hamilton, and how local order emerged as lifeforms: devices that accelerate dissipation. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v175_living.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 03_2> The Emergence of the Living Cognizer](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v180_mind.en.html): From the Cambrian explosion to writing: lifeforms that acquired a cognitive system for handling representations. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v180_mind.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 03_3> The Default Settings of the Living Cognizer](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v181_default.en.html): There is no flawless agent. Ambiguity and anxiety are the defaults of the living cognizer. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v181_default.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 04_1> Axis Coordinate Systems](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v170_axes.en.html): The basic component of cognitive computation is the axis coordinate system: number of axes, axis names, units, coordinates. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v170_axes.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 04_2> The Absence of Transformation](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v171_transform.en.html): Real cognitive computation has no transformation. What can't be carried over gets borrowed. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v171_transform.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 04_3> Identity Is a Matter of Scale](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v172_identity.en.html): Mercury's orbit, manufacturing tolerances, yesterday's self. Being the same means the difference falls below the scale. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v172_identity.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 04_4> Tensors and JSON](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v173_tensor.en.html): In an axis coordinate system, only the coordinates are in focus. JSON is the container that pairs them with axis names and carries them. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v173_tensor.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 05_1> Avatar, Handler, Governor](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w395v181_avatar.en.html): Split the living cognizer into body, self-consciousness and second-order representation, and the multilayer control structure turns out to run the same way even when the domain changes. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w395v181_avatar.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 05_2> The Trigger Sentence and Myeongchal](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w395v182_trigger.en.html): One sentence, that we have never left the here-now, switches the governor on, and a governor that is on shows up as myeongchal. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w395v182_trigger.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 05_3> Narratives of Arrival, and Where We Part](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w395v183_arrival.en.html): Where do look-alike tripartite schemes such as Vedanta, Gnosticism, Sufism, Kabbalah and Dzogchen part ways with the governor? Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w395v183_arrival.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 05_4> Functionalism, and Where We Part](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w395v184_functionalism.en.html): The distance between the governor concept and theories that describe only function, with no metaphysics: Damasio, Metzinger, Graziano, higher-order theory, Kim Joo-hwan and Polanyi. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w395v184_functionalism.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 05_5> Filtering by the Maxim](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w395v185_filter.en.html): Information is used to set the scale on the axes a purpose raises, so a proposition that can't move that scale drops out. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w395v185_filter.ko.html
- [<Cognitive Axioms 05_6> Governing and Handling](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w395v190_governing.en.html): Move the multilayer control structure into the domain of operations, and it turns out that the next axis goes up while nothing happens. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w395v190_governing.ko.html

## Vox

- [That Damned Ether](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w394v084_vox0003.en.html): A dialogue that starts from the origin of ether and ends where the demand to get rid of magic is met by spacetime without ether, splitting into the graviton and Navier–Stokes. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w394v084_vox0003.ko.html
- [The Mind to Keep, the Mind to Choose](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w394v053_vox0002.en.html): A dialogue that starts from the ceiling on human lifespan and ends at a body that can be replaced, a mind that must stay the original, and power that must be filtered by the mind. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w394v053_vox0002.ko.html
- [From Time to Mass](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w393v174_vox0001.en.html): A dialogue that starts from which physical quantity is defined first and ends at mass as frequency in time while at rest in space. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w393v174_vox0001.ko.html

## Snap

- [LDL, Atherosclerosis, apoB](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w393v150_apob.en.html): One scene: cholesterol as a delivery box. Starting from the fact that the box has no address, and ending where every driver of atherosclerosis converges on one number, the count of apoB particles in the blood. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w393v150_apob.ko.html
- [A Story About Salt](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w392v012_salt.en.html): One tub of salted fish. From the number stamped under a container, through cans and wrappers, to the salt on the table. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w392v012_salt.ko.html
- [Why Billing Needs a Fixed Basis](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v162_billing.en.html): 1% used. Of what? One gauge with no denominator, and why AI services need a billing basis that never changes. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w391v162_billing.ko.html
- [Particle Physics and the Established Foothold](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v144_fob.en.html): Dr. Park Moon-ho's lecture, 33:50 to 1:19:34. From the discovery of the nucleus to the Copenhagen institute: each foothold secured, then used as the next starting point. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w386v144_fob.ko.html
- [A Word About Claymore](https://bs2fob.com/p/26w384v193_claymore.en.html): How far do you open it? One gauge, and from there the template that charges cannibalism as the price — where it started and how far it spread. Korean original: https://bs2fob.com/p/26w384v193_claymore.ko.html
